review_candidates.title: Executive Secretary
review_candidates.description: About Us As the world’s largest family of luxury hotels, we all take great pride in being genuine ambassadors of the InterContinental® brand. Shaped by decades of international know-how and local insights, our passion for luxury travel spans cultures and customs. Inspiring us to create warm and sophisticated experiences for those seeking a richer perspective on the world. Towering over the city center, our luxury Doha hotel is one of the tallest in Qatar. You’ll find us in the exclusive West Bay area, close to the city’s Doha Exhibition and Convention Centre, government offices, and corporate headquarters. Our spacious rooms and suites have panoramic city and sea views, while award-winning restaurants, state-of-the-art meeting venues, easy access to local highlights, a health, and fitness club, and a rooftop pool, ensure a memorable stay InterContinental Doha The City is looking for an Executive Secretary to join our team. As an Executive Secretary , you will bring ambition, talent, and the right blend of core skills to this pivotal role. We're looking for someone who: Demonstrates a genuine, natural sense of hospitality; brings prior work experience in hotel operational departments; has a proven track record of successful, high-level administrative support; can handle guest and stakeholder interactions with composure, discretion, and a smile even under pressure; and possesses excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the professionalism expected at GM office level Your day-to-day Manage the General Manager's calendar, meetings, travel arrangements, and daily priorities. Prepare correspondence, reports, presentations, and meeting minutes. Coordinate communication between the Executive Office and hotel departments. Handle confidential information, documents, and records with discretion. Welcome and assist VIP guests, coordinating special requests with relevant departments. Support guest correspondence, feedback, and Executive Office communications. Process purchase requests, invoices, expense reports, and maintain office supplies. Organize business travel, events, and Executive Committee meetings. Maintain accurate filing systems and ensure compliance with IHG policies and procedures. Support the General Manager with administrative tasks and other duties as required. What We Need From You Bachelor’s degree 3–5 years of experience as an Executive Secretary, Executive Assistant or similar administrative role. Strong proficiency in MS Office (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and document/data management systems Excellent organizational, multitasking, and time-management skills, with high attention to detail and discretion Excellent organizational and follow-up skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and initiatives. Previous experience within IHG Hotels & Resorts or another international luxury hospitality group would be an advantage. What We Offer In return, we offer competitive pay and benefits, and a chance to work with a great team of talented people. Most importantly, we'll give you the room to be yourself. So what's your passion? Please get in touch if this position matches your skills and interests and tell us how you could bring your individual competencies by clicking “Apply Online” Our mission is to welcome everyone and create inclusive teams where we celebrate difference and encourage colleagues to bring their whole selves to work. IHG Hotels & Resorts provides equal employment opportunities to applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or disability. We promote a culture of trust, support, and acceptance. Always welcoming different backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. IHG gives every member of the team the room they need to belong, grow and make a difference in a collaborative environment. We know that to work well, we need to feel well – both inside and outside of work – and through our myWellbeing framework, we are committed to supporting wellbeing in your health, lifestyle, and workplace. So, join us and you’ll become part of our ever-growing global family. Don't quite meet every single requirement, but still believe you'd be a great fit for the job? We'll never know unless you hit the 'Apply' button. Start your journey with us today.

review_candidates.title: Delivery Network Coordinator (Exams)
review_candidates.description: We support peace and prosperity by building connections, understanding and trust between people in the UK and countries worldwide. For 90 years we have shaped brighter futures through education, arts, culture, language, and creativity. Working with people in over 200 countries and territories, we are on the ground in more than 100 countries. We connect. We inspire. Role Description/Purpose The British Council is looking for an organised and detail-oriented Exams Delivery Network Coordinator to join our Exams & English Operations team. This is an exciting opportunity to play a key role in ensuring the secure, compliant, and efficient delivery of examinations across a country or location. In this role, you will coordinate all aspects of exam delivery operations, supporting the successful execution of test-day and post-test activities. You will ensure that venues, equipment, materials, and staffing arrangements are in place and fully compliant with British Council and awarding body requirements. Your work will be central to maintaining the highest standards of quality, security, and customer service throughout the exam cycle. You will be responsible for overseeing the planning, selection, contracting, and coordination of both internal and external venues, ensuring that resources are available, cost-effective, and fit for purpose. Working closely with internal teams, suppliers, and stakeholders, you will ensure operational readiness for all examinations and support the smooth delivery of services across your assigned location. As part of the Operational Delivery function within Exams & English Operations, you will contribute to maintaining exam integrity and compliance with global Standard Operating Procedures. You will also support continuous improvement initiatives, helping to enhance operational efficiency, strengthen logistics processes, and improve the overall customer experience. The successful candidate will be highly organised, capable of managing multiple priorities, and committed to delivering high-quality operational support in a fast-paced environment. You will have strong coordination and stakeholder management skills, a keen eye for detail, and the ability to work effectively within established procedures and compliance frameworks. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys operational planning, problem-solving, and delivering services that make a positive impact on customers and colleagues alike. Role Accountabilities As an Exams Delivery Network Coordinator, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the secure, efficient, and compliant delivery of examinations across your country or location. You will coordinate all operational aspects of test-day and post-test activities, ensuring that delivery is carried out in line with global Standard Operating Procedures, security requirements, and quality standards. You will oversee the sourcing, contracting, and performance management of examination venues and third-party delivery partners, ensuring services are delivered efficiently, compliantly, and with a strong focus on value for money. The role also involves coordinating the procurement, maintenance, and readiness of equipment and materials required for exam delivery, including laptops, scanners, signage, and secure storage facilities. Ensuring the secure handling, transportation, and tracking of confidential examination materials will be a key responsibility. Working closely with colleagues, venues, suppliers, and delivery partners, you will lead operational readiness checks, venue audits, and risk assessments to ensure all examinations are delivered smoothly and securely. You will coordinate test-day staffing arrangements to maintain appropriate operational coverage and may also participate in delivery rosters when required. As the primary operational point of contact for venues, test-day staff, and delivery partners, you will manage the escalation of issues, coordinate incident responses, and ensure effective communication with relevant stakeholders. A strong focus on risk management and compliance is central to this role. You will ensure adherence to all security, regulatory, and integrity requirements related to exams delivery. You will support compliance audits, incident investigations, and the maintenance of accurate operational records and audit trails, while working closely with Governance and Compliance colleagues to provide assurance that operational standards are consistently met. The role also requires effective stakeholder engagement and customer focus. You will coordinate operational communications with candidates, partners, and internal teams, ensuring that customer feedback and observations from test days are captured, reviewed, and acted upon. You will work proactively with venue owners, suppliers, and delivery partners to address service, compliance, or performance issues and to drive continuous improvement. In addition, you will support the efficient management of resources by overseeing venue and supplier contracts, purchase orders, payments, and cost tracking. You will ensure that venues, materials, equipment, and staffing resources are used effectively and in line with organisational policies and procedures. This position may involve the supervision of Delivery Network Assistants, venue staff, and temporary test-day teams. You will contribute to developing staff capability through training and guidance on operational procedures, compliance requirements, and risk management practices. You will help foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, security, and continuous improvement, ensuring high standards are maintained across all aspects of exam delivery. This is an excellent opportunity for a highly organised professional who enjoys operational coordination, stakeholder engagement, and delivering exceptional service in a fast-paced and quality-driven environment. Essentials Qualifications & Experience The British Council systems and global processes operate in English. Written and verbal proficiency in English is required. Experience coordinating secure, regulated service delivery (e.g. exams, logistics, events). Proven ability to manage venues, equipment, and logistics to strict security and quality standards. Experience supervising staff or contractors. Desirables Lean Six Sigma qualification. Experience working with awarding bodies or educational assessment services. Good understanding of compliance, confidentiality, and audit requirements. Important Information To ensure a consistent evaluation process, candidates are required to upload their CV in English. Location: Colombo, Jaffna and Kandy (On-site working model). Salary: Pay band 4. Contract type: Indefinite. Proof of Identity & Right to Work: Locally Recruited - Applications are welcomed from candidates currently in this location with a natural right to work. Applications are also welcomed from candidates currently based in other British Council country offices. However, please note candidates must have a natural right to work in the country, on a permanent basis, as immigration clearance and/or on-going visa support is not provided by the British Council for this role. Relocation support is also not provided. Closing date – Tuesday 29 September 2026. A connected and trusted UK in a more connected and trusted world. Equality, Diversity and Inclusion Statement We are committed to equality, diversity and inclusion and welcome applications from all sections of the community as we believe that a diverse workforce gives added depth to our work. The British Council is a Disability Confident Employer. The Disability Confident scheme helps challenge attitudes, increase understanding of disability and ensure staff are drawn from the widest possible pool of talent. We guarantee an interview for disabled applicants who meet the minimum role requirements. We welcome discussions about specific requirements or adjustments to enable participation and engagement in our work and activities. Safeguarding Statement The British Council is committed to safeguarding children, young people and adults who we work with. We believe that all children and adults everywhere in the world deserve to live in safe environments and have the right to be protected from all forms of abuse, maltreatment and exploitation as set out in article 19, UNCRC (United Nations Convention on the Rights of the Child) 1989. Appointment to positions where there is direct involvement with vulnerable groups will be dependent on thorough checks being completed in line with legal requirements and with the British Council’s Safeguarding policies for Adults and Children. If you experience any difficulties with submitting your application, please email askhr@britishcouncil.org

review_candidates.title: Cardiac Surgeon
review_candidates.description: Our leading healthcare facility is looking for an experienced Cardiac Surgeon to provide comprehensive surgical care for patients with complex cardiovascular conditions. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in adult cardiac surgery, excellent operative skills, and a commitment to patient-centered care. Cardiac Surgery is an established UAE licensing title. Key Responsibilities Evaluate, diagnose, and manage patients requiring cardiac surgical intervention. Perform elective and emergency cardiac surgical procedures within the scope of expertise. Perform procedures including CABG, valve repair and replacement, aortic surgery, and other cardiac interventions. Conduct detailed pre-operative assessments and develop individualized surgical plans. Provide comprehensive post-operative care and monitor patients for complications. Review and interpret echocardiography, coronary angiography, CT, MRI, laboratory results, and other investigations. Manage high-risk and emergency cardiac surgical cases. Collaborate closely with cardiologists, anesthesiologists, intensivists, radiologists, and other specialists. Participate in multidisciplinary heart-team discussions and treatment planning. Counsel patients and families regarding surgical options, risks, benefits, and expected outcomes. Maintain accurate medical records and ensure compliance with UAE healthcare regulations. Participate in clinical audits, quality improvement initiatives, teaching, and continuing medical education. Requirements Qualifications & Requirements MBBS or equivalent medical degree. MS / MCh / DNB / FRCS / Arab Board or equivalent recognized postgraduate qualification in Cardiac Surgery / Cardiovascular Surgery. Minimum 5 years of post-specialization clinical experience preferred. Strong experience in cardiac surgical procedures and perioperative management. Excellent surgical judgment, technical skills, and decision-making abilities. Strong communication and multidisciplinary teamwork skills. Surgical logbook may be required as part of UAE licensing eligibility for surgical specialties Benefits Private Health Insurance Paid Time Off Training & Development Performance Bonus

review_candidates.title: Senior Software Engineer - GraphAware Hume
review_candidates.description: About Neo4j Neo4j is the graph intelligence platform that transforms data into knowledge to power the next generation of intelligent applications and AI systems. It includes enterprise-ready knowledge graphs for accurate, explainable, and governed AI; the most comprehensive, trusted, and easy-to-deploy graph capabilities across any environment and data source; and an unmatched ecosystem trusted by 84 of the Fortune 100 and supported by the world’s largest graph community. Intelligence that works. Results that matter. Built to work everywhere and integrate with everything across every cloud for dynamic, personalized, and autonomous AI systems. We deliver quicker results, contextual knowledge, and solutions that impact customers and employees across the business. Our Vision At Neo4j, we have always strived to help the world make sense of data. As business, society and knowledge become increasingly connected, our technology promotes innovation by helping organizations to find and understand data relationships. We created, drive and lead the graph database category, and we’re disrupting how organizations leverage their data to innovate and stay competitive. The Team Product Engineering at Neo4j GraphAware offers a unique opportunity to build real-world intelligence systems that matter. We are aiming to hire someone in the the UK, Czechia or Italy. Build with purpose: Your code will help law enforcement and analysts save lives and protect communities through better data insight. Innovative tech: Work with knowledge graphs, workflow engines, LLMs, and graph-native UIs pushing the boundaries of data analytics. Shape the future: Contribute to product direction and technical vision alongside a senior engineering team. True autonomy: Own your work, from ideation to deployment, in a remote-first team. Global mindset: Collaborate with a world-class team of engineers, data scientists, and product thinkers across Europe and beyond. Growth without bureaucracy: Develop your skills in a non-micromanaged, excellence-driven environment The Role As a Senior Software Engineer, you will shape the core intelligence of GraphAware Hume, our graph-powered analytics platform. Your Responsibilities Will Include Building APIs for intuitive user interaction with complex data Designing secure, scalable access control systems for mission-critical environments Orchestrating workflows to automate graph analytics, inference, and real-time insights Optimizing application performance and collaborating with other engineers to ensure seamless user experiences Contributing to architecture and technical design with the team What you must know already and be excited to grow further Proven experience in backend systems (8+ years) with exposure to large-scale, complex applications and cross-functional teams Fluency in Java, with a deep understanding of modern software engineering principles, including: Clean Architecture, Domain-Driven Design (DDD), and Test-Driven Development (TDD) Advanced debugging and profiling techniques, Writing composable, maintainable, and testable code Spring or similar frameworks with emphasis on building secure, modular, and scalable APIs Experience designing data models, both relational (e.g., PostgreSQL) and ideally graph-based (Neo4j or similar) Working knowledge of modern CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Docker), and automated deployment workflows Strong security mindset, with practical knowledge of secure software design and common vulnerabilities (e.g., OWASP) Comfortable with remote team collaboration, i.e. tools and practices for asynchronous communication Bonus Points For Familiarity With Graph technologies: Cypher, Neo4j, knowledge graph Event-driven architectures, Kafka, or distributed systems Cloud-native development, observability, and performance tuning Experience working with LLMs or integrating AI/ML into production systems
